tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: I opened the app, saw the dialog 'Bitte Bahn 1 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen.' and clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'. Bahn 1 started at speed 60. After the 25 s wait the dialog still read 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' with no button and did not ask for Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Any number of stops, the same stop several times, one list per train
Expected: 'Bahn 2' lists all 8 stops without an error or limit message, and its stops 1 and 3 both show 'Haltestelle 4'; 'Bahn 1' has exactly 1 stop, the stops of 'Bahn 2' do not appear in its list
Observed failure: 8 stops were added with no limit message, and stops 1 and 3 were set to 'Haltestelle 4'. Bahn 1 correctly showed exactly 1 stop. After switching back to Bahn 2 it still had 8 stops and stop 1 still showed 'Haltestelle 4', but stop 3 had reverted to 'Haltestelle 1'. The second 'Haltestelle 4' selection was not kept.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: Setup and Start worked, and a new 'Start' entry appeared at 22:05:38. After that the Betriebsprotokoll showed no new entries at all: no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', no 'fährt weiter', no 'erreicht'. (Tester note: only about 30 s of waiting happened before the final read instead of 135 s, and the action budget was used up.)
Steps completed before failure: 8
